text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Perubatan (Pindaan Jadual Kedua)

(No. 5) 2018.

Pindaan Jadual Kedua

2. Jadual Kedua kepada Akta Perubatan 1971 dipinda berhubung dengan negara

"Russia", dengan menggantikan butiran "I.M. Sechenov Moscow Medical Academy or

Moscow Medical Academy (MMA) (official name is State Educational Establishment of

Higher Vocational Training I.M. Sechenov Moscow Medical Academy)" dan butir-butir

yang berhubungan dengannya butiran dan butir-butir yang berikut:

Nama Institusi yang

memberikan kelulusan

Perihal kelulusan

"I.M. Sechenov Moscow Medical Academy atau

Moscow Medical Academy (MMA) (official name is

State Educational Establishment of Higher Vocational

Training I.M. Sechenov Moscow Medical Academy)—

(a) yang didaftarkan sebagai State Educational

Institution of Highest Vocational Education

Moscow Medical Academy dinamai

bersempena dengan nama I.M. Sechenov of

Federal Agency of Health and Social

Development pada 10 Mac 2005;

(a) Doctor of

Medicine in

General Medicine

(sebelum 3 Mei

2001, dikecualikan

daripada diiktiraf)

(b) Doctor of Medicine

in General

Medicine MD".

(b) yang didaftarkan sebagai State Educational

Institution of Highest Vocational Education

First Moscow State Medical University dinamai

bersempena dengan nama I.M. Sechenov of

Ministry of Health and Social Development of

Russian Federation pada 19 Julai 2010;

(c) yang didaftarkan sebagai State Budget

Educational Institution of Highest Vocational

Education First Moscow State Medical

University dinamai bersempena dengan nama

I.M. Sechenov of Ministry of Health and

Social Development of Russian Federation

pada 19 Julai 2011; dan

(d) yang didaftarkan sebagai Federal State

Autonomous Educational Institution of Higher

Education I.M. Sechenov First Moscow State

Medical University of the Ministry of Health of

the Russian Federation atau Sechenov

University pada 11 Mei 2017.

Dibuat 24 Ogos 2018

[KKM-60(20/2)/1/7; PN(PU2)97/VIII]

DR. DZULKEFLY BIN AHMAD

Menteri Kesihatan

MEDICAL ACT 1971

MEDICAL (AMENDMENT OF SECOND SCHEDULE) (NO. 5) ORDER 2018

Medical Act 1971 [Act 50], the Minister, after consulting the Council, makes the
